data.title: 贝塔 · 地下指控所的沙盘谍报复盘
data.description: 阴影庭园地下作战室内，立体的魔力全息沙盘散发着深蓝幽光。贝塔指尖延伸出纤细的史莱姆魔力线操纵信标，神情机敏锐利。
data.location: dim high-tech underground command sanctum with glowing magical projection terrain table
data.action: leaning over glowing tactical projection map, fingertips emitting fine glowing magical slime threads to direct tokens, focused sharp expression
data.lighting: 魔力全息蓝光与暗室环境光
data.promptProse: Beta leans over a glowing tactical magic map in a dimly lit command room, manipulating shimmering slime threads with keen strategic focus.
data.animaCaption: Blue map glow illuminates her silver hair and focused expression as she guides the threads.
